title: Objective autonomous loop: canonical terminal verdict takes headline precedence
description: Frontend-only headline precedence fix vs BASE e2d7985b52cab9cf3c9acb05c0f5f5e855683afa. Canonical status on an identity-verified ready cockpit read (ACHIEVED, INFEASIBLE, EXPIRED, CANCELLED — the closed terminal set) determines terminal aggregate headline ahead of independently observed blocked scheduler nodes. ACHIEVED reuses proven/green; negative terminal statuses use failed/red. Observation-integrity note remains explicit; nonterminal/unknown/missing/error/foreign cockpit reads preserve existing bad-node precedence. No node/edge changes, authority, API, persistence or scheduler changes. Added Vitest terminal headline fail-closed regressions and a routed-response Playwright scenario confirming green terminal headline + retained red scheduler and integrity badge. This branch is for independent verification; no tests or verify:change were executed in the connector-only environment.
